question: How are further days assigned to kula lineages?
premises: Ocean protector moon belongs to vaiṣṇavi.
Thirteenth belongs to aindri; two to vārāhi; pair to caṇḍi.
inference: Further days are assigned to kula lineages.
plain_english: Ocean protector moon belongs to vaiṣṇavi; thirteenth to aindri; two to vārāhi; and a pair to caṇḍi.
